name: pre-pr-qa-toolkit
description: Real-browser pre-PR feature audits and CityCatalyst demo recording.

interface.shortDescription: Audit product features in a real browser before a PR.
interface.longDescription: Record reproducible browser walkthroughs, run critical user-centered feature audits, add an optional independent Expect pass, and record the standard CityCatalyst demo.
defaultPrompt: Critically audit this branch as a user before its PR.
Record a browser walkthrough and report what breaks.
Record and audit the standard CityCatalyst demo.
